quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a right turn, both the approach for the right turn and the right turn must be made from the right turn lane if the highway has a right turn lane as set forth in subsection 4 of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b], or must be made from the extreme right lane.

activation.condition: Identified driver intends right turn at a public-highway non-alley intersection.

obligation.description: Both approach and right turn from the qualified right-turn lane, or the extreme right lane if no such lane exists.

timing.description: Observe source-joined approach and turn intervals separately; no numeric entry deadline is supplied.

parameter_refs.name: qualifying_right_turn_lane
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed NRS 484B.223(4) qualification true or false
